§6Vacuum-Chamber High Power Laser Emitter§f is a 3x3x5 multiblock that provides the focused beam the Precision Laser Etcher needs to write circuit patterns onto plates. It has no GUI of its own, it connects to the Etcher via multiblock detection.

The recipe is straightforward: 1 Lens Block, 1 Aluminum Plate, 1 Red Crystal Block, and 1 Machine Structure. The Red Crystal Block comes from sapphire-oxide processing in the Arc Furnace.

Without this emitter, you cannot etch Advanced Circuit Plates or Integrated Circuits, which gates the Chemical Reactor, Electrolyser, and Centrifuge.

§ePS:§f Build the Lens Block and at least one Red Crystal Block before attempting this quest. The recipe itself is cheap.
